watch_list.summary: Lauren points to a /correct skill that has your agent reflect on repeated mistakes and then write the deterministic checks for you.

watch_list.short_title: Dr Eggbot in the community directory
watch_list.summary: Lauren submitted Dr Eggbot v2 to the new Grok Bot community directory at grok-bot.directory, where you can browse and install community bots.

items.title: Grok Bot 201
items.summary: A 58-minute SpaceXSI workshop where Ria Goveas and Audrey Leung show how to design a Bot thoughtfully and chain Bots into a workflow, including a live Notion-to-message handoff, Team Bot sharing, and approval rules.

items.title: Why the War Rhino Looks Like It Survived a Battle
items.summary: A 39-second comparison of a single AI model versus a full creature pipeline: Soul alone makes the War Rhino look like rubber and plastic, while the pipeline version shows battle wear—an arrow in its back, mud in the fur, and a torn red flag on the horn.

items.title: Why Your Eyes Can't Tell AI From a Film Set
items.summary: A 38-second quiz of six creature photos—costume on a film set or AI—then a reveal of a movie-creature-shop pipeline: clay for the shape, Soul for the materials, and a plain flash photo in a real room.

items.title: I Made an AI Alien You Could Actually Dissect
items.summary: A 49-second 4K creature short: an alien built like a body, not a rubber suit, with visible ribs and bone plates from a clay sculpt, Soul 2 materials, a flash-photo reference sheet, and Seedance 2.5.

items.title: AI Agent要跑在哪？AI寫完網站該怎麼部署？從零教你如何讓AI工具正式上線！｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: Kelly walks through, from scratch, where an AI agent should run and how to deploy an AI-built website so the tool can actually go live.
